# Recipe Source

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The origin or provenance of a recipe, such as the website, cookbook, or person it was sourced from.

## Scope note

Attribution/provenance metadata (e.g. PTE, DMP as web sources), distinct from RecipeImages or Nutrition.

## Broader

- [Recipe](../Recipe/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
